         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         addw.z        VF01,VF01,VF00w            isubiu        VI03,VI03,1                ; work group z + 1
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; the branch reads VI after one instruction
         NOP                                      ibne          VI03,VI00,mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_gz
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
; back to the task program, if one called
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI15,89(VI00)
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; the branch reads VI after one instruction
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI15,VI00,mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_stop
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      jr            VI15
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_stop:
; stop
         NOP[E]                                   NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
		.align 4
mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_CodeEnd:
		.global	mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_Clamp0
		.global	mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_Clamp1
		.global	mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_Clamp2
		.global	mesh_shared_barrier_mesh_Clamp3
